title: Researchers: NASA Asteroid Samples Contain ‘Building Blocks’ of Life
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Scientists examining material collected from an asteroid say it appears to contain some of the chemical building blocks of life.
sentences.zh: 科学家对从一个小行星上收集的材料进行检查后发现,该物质似乎含有一些化学生命构件。

sentences.en: The American spacecraft OSIRIS-REx collected the samples in 2020 from the asteroid Bennu.
sentences.zh: 美国的OSIRIS-REx航天器于2020年从小行星Bennu采集了样本。

sentences.en: In 2023, the spacecraft sent the rock and dust material back to Earth in a special container that landed by parachute.
sentences.zh: 2023年,该航天器用降落伞降落的特殊容器将岩石和尘土运回地球。

sentences.en: Scientists from the American space agency NASA recovered the samples in the western state of Utah.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局的科学家们在犹他州西部找到了这些样品。

sentences.en: OSIRIS-REx is already on its way to another asteroid called Apophis.
sentences.zh: OSIRIS -REX已经在去另一个叫阿波菲斯的小行星的路上了

sentences.en: It is expected to reach that asteroid in 2029.
sentences.zh: 预计2029年将到达该小行星。

sentences.en: On Bennu, the spacecraft collected a total of 122 grams of material.
sentences.zh: 在Bennu,航天器共收集了122克材料。

sentences.en: This is believed to be the largest sample collected from beyond the moon.
sentences.zh: 据信这是从月球外采集的最大样本。

sentences.en: NASA has shared some of the material with international researchers.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局与国际研究人员分享了一些材料。

sentences.en: Two research groups released studies last week describing results of their examinations of the asteroid material.
sentences.zh: 两个研究小组上星期发布了一些研究报告,介绍了对小行星材料的研究结果。

sentences.en: One study , published in Nature Astronomy , suggested the samples contained a mixture of organic compounds.
sentences.zh: 一份研究报告发表在《自然天文学》上,其中指出样品含有有机化合物混合物。

sentences.en: Organic compounds have one or more carbon atoms that attach to other elements, usually hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen and sulfur.
sentences.zh: 有机化合物有一个或多个碳原子附于其他元素,通常是氢、氧、氮和硫。

sentences.en: All life on Earth is based on carbon and is built from organic compounds.
sentences.zh: 地球上的所有生命都以碳为基础,由有机化合物组成。

sentences.en: The other study, published in Nature , provides evidence that a much larger object, which Bennu is believed to have broken off from, once held salty, liquid water.
sentences.zh: 另一篇在《自然》杂志上发表的研究报告提供了证据,表明据信Bennu曾经与含盐的液体水断裂的更大物体。

sentences.en: The researchers said this suggests that in the early solar system, asteroids such as Bennu might have transported water and life-supporting chemicals to other planets and moons.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说,这表明在早期的太阳系中,诸如Bennu等小行星可能已经将水和生命支持化学品运到其他行星和卫星。

sentences.en: Researchers from both groups noted it was important that the samples they worked with came directly from the asteroid itself.
sentences.zh: 两个小组的研究人员都指出,他们工作的样品必须直接来自小行星本身。

sentences.en: Asteroid pieces that fall to Earth turn into meteorites, and chemicals inside the samples can be changed or lost.
sentences.zh: 落到地球的小行星碎片变成陨石 样本中的化学物质会被改变或丢失

sentences.en: In a statement, NASA said the findings do not provide direct evidence of life itself.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局在一份声明中说,调查结果没有提供生命本身的直接证据。

sentences.en: However, the space agency said, “They do suggest the conditions necessary for the emergence of life were widespread across the early solar system.” This increases the chances that “life could have formed on other planets and moons,” the statement added.
sentences.zh: 但是,航天局说,“它们确实表明,早期太阳系普遍存在着生命出现的必要条件。 ”这增加了“在其他行星和卫星上形成生命的可能性,”该声明补充说。

sentences.en: The parent of Bennu is believed to be an icy body measuring about 100 kilometers across.
sentences.zh: 本努的母体被认为是一个冰冷的身体 大约横跨100公里。

sentences.en: Scientists believe the body formed in the outer solar system and was later destroyed, possibly 1 to 2 billion years ago.
sentences.zh: 科学家们相信这具尸体是在外太阳系形成的 后来被摧毁了 可能是10亿到20亿年前

sentences.en: The pieces that broke off likely formed Bennu and other asteroids observed to be masses of loose material, rather than solid objects.
sentences.zh: 断裂的碎片可能形成本努和其他小行星,观测到这些小行星是由松散物质而不是固态物体构成的。

sentences.en: Nicky Fox is the associate administrator for NASA’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington D.C.
sentences.zh: Nicky Fox是美国航天局华盛顿特区科学飞行任务局的副局长。

sentences.en: She praised the OSIRIS-REx mission, saying it was “already rewriting the textbook on what we understand about the beginnings of our solar system.”
sentences.zh: 她赞美了OSIRIS-REx飞行任务,并说它“已经根据我们对太阳系起始点的理解重写教科书了”。

sentences.en: Fox added that she hopes the samples can help scientists understand “what ingredients in our solar system existed before life started on Earth.”
sentences.zh: 福克斯补充说,她希望这些样本能帮助科学家了解“我们太阳系中存在哪些成分,而地球的生命才刚刚开始。”

sentences.en: Tim McCoy is a researcher at the U.S. Smithsonian Institution and was a lead writer of the Nature study.
sentences.zh: Tim McCoy是美国史密森学院的研究员 也是自然研究的主要作者

sentences.en: He told the Associated Press (AP) that the samples may provide details about "the kind of environment that could have been essential to the steps that lead from elements to life.”
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社(AP),样本可以提供“对从元素走向生命的步骤至关重要的环境类型”的细节。

sentences.en: He noted that combining the ingredients of life with an environment of sodium-rich water is “really the pathway to life.” He added the samples suggest the processes involving the chemical compounds “probably occurred much earlier and were much more widespread than we had thought before."
sentences.zh: 他指出,将生命的成分与富钠水环境结合起来“确实是生命之路”。 他补充说,样本表明,涉及化学化合物的工艺“可能发生得早得多,而且比我们以前想象的要广泛得多”。

sentences.en: Yasuhito Sekine is with the Institute of Science in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 康喜托·塞金是东京科学研究所的研究员。

sentences.en: He did not take part in the new research.
sentences.zh: 他没有参加新的研究。

sentences.en: Sekine confirmed the findings were only made possible by examining samples “collected directly from the asteroid, then carefully preserved back on Earth."
sentences.zh: Sekine证实,只有对“直接从小行星上采集,然后小心保存在地球上”的样品进行检查,才可能得出这些结论。

sentences.en: Jason Dworkin is a project scientist for the OSIRIS-REx mission at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Maryland.
sentences.zh: Jason Dworkin是美国航天局马里兰Goddard空间飞行中心OSIRIS-REx飞行任务的项目科学家。

sentences.en: He told Reuters news agency that all biology is made up of organic compounds.
sentences.zh: 他告诉路透社 所有生物都是有机化合物组成的

sentences.en: And some of those may have survived 4.5 billion years.
sentences.zh: 其中有些人可能活了45亿年。

sentences.en: Dworkin said the materials from OSIRIS-REx provide new details about a solar system that might have had the right elements to support life.
sentences.zh: Dworkin说,来自OSIRIS-REx的材料提供了关于一个可能具有支持生命的适当元素的太阳系的新细节。

sentences.en: But he added that one of the most interesting questions, still remains: “Why we, so far, only see life on Earth and not elsewhere.”
sentences.zh: 但他补充说,最有趣的问题之一仍然存在:“为什么我们迄今只看到地球上的生命,而没有看到其他地方的生命。”

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from The Associated Press, Reuters, Agence France- Presse and NASA.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩·林恩。布莱恩·林恩根据美联社、路透社、法国新闻社和美国航天局的报告,为VOA学习英语撰写了这个故事。
